I could not read the paper. Every route to fetch it was blocked by this session's permission settings, so I have nothing to summarize.

What I tried:

- **WebFetch** on both the abstract page and the PDF was denied.
- **curl through the proxy** to the abstract page was also denied, both as a compound command and as a single plain command.

I will not guess at the contents from the arXiv ID alone, since that would risk inventing a paper.

To get a real summary, any one of these will unblock me:

1. Approve the WebFetch or curl request when it appears, and I will fetch and summarize the paper immediately.
2. Paste the abstract or full text into the chat.
3. Drop the PDF into the worktree or scratchpad and tell me the path. I can extract and summarize it locally.
